# Adam Olšer

> Software engineer based in Barcelona. I build software that people use every day and rarely have to think about.

## Selected work
- [Capy Onsen](https://adam-olser.github.io/capy-onsen/): pixel-art capybara onsen with six mini-games
- [QR Studio](https://adam-olser.github.io/qr-studio/): QR code generator with a rate-limited backend
- [Drift Board](https://driftboard-4yjg.onrender.com/): collaborative kanban board that syncs live
- [React Music Player](https://react-music-app-adamo.netlify.app/): minimal music player with keyboard controls
